[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_436b808ca1824610a71b9d5480fdf33b~mv2.png[/img]

[h1]Installing the Early Beta of Silver Cats v1.3[/h1]

If you have an old version of the game (v1.2) installed, it is recommended to uninstall it first. After that, to take part in testing, you need to go to the game properties in Steam and in the "Betas" section select the branch ‘v1-3_beta’, after that you can start downloading.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_f952a28e7d6b42fdb6249976c4347eee~mv2.jpg[/img]

If there are any bugs or other issues with the new version, I'd appreciate it if you report them in the game Discord or on the Steam community forum.

[h2]Patch 31.03.2025 (v1.3 Early Beta)[/h2]

[h3]New weapons:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Imrag's Axe (can be purchased from Imrag in the Meeting Room for 32 emerald coins);
[*] Blacksmith's Hammer (can be purchased from the blacksmith in the Miners Valley for 83 coins);
[/list]

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] updated the graphics of 12 characters of the Miners Valley;
[*] optimized loading of locations with a large number of characters and monsters;
[*] minor edits were made to the design of previously made characters from the Guild Residence;
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.3: Gameplay Test #1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4qf03XX9mrI;full][/previewyoutube]

Gameplay video of the first location from the Update v1.3. Currently working on the first stage of the update: the environment graphics update. I also changed the map and quest window for a future UI update, as the old map stopped working after the game was transferred to the new engine version.  


There are six stages planned for Update 1.3:

[olist]
[*] Environment (update vegetation, buildings, etc.)
[*] Characters (update the main character, NPCs, monsters, bosses)
[*] Animations (update the main character and NPC animations)
[*] Combat (changing combat to non-target system)
[*] Interface (update interface graphics, possibly with adaptation for gamepad)
[*] Partial voice acting (Ukrainian voice acting of main character and story NPCs)
[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472320

notes.title: Working on updating graphics in Silver Cats v1.3: Part 1
notes.notes:
Some time after the release of Silver Cats, I started working on a new project and had already purchased new graphics for it, but still decided that it was better to clean up the old project first, and then take on the new one. So in early 2022, I ported Silver Cats to a new version of the engine and started working on updating the graphics using purchased content.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_8696d9104980426a832debb932fd8326~mv2.jpg[/img]

I decided to divide the work on the update into six stages, which will be carried out in stages:

[olist]
[*] Environment (updating vegetation, buildings, etc.)
[*] Characters (updating the main character, NPCs, monsters, bosses)
[*] Animations (updating animations of the main character and NPCs)
[*] Combat (change combat to non-target system)
[*] Interface (updating interface graphics, possibly with adaptation for a gamepad)
[*] Partial voice acting (Ukrainian voice acting of the main character and story NPCs)
[/olist]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_3be2a62b4faf4957a79a3592645c3ca5~mv2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_f1430381b8774456aa1ba3838affc8de~mv2.jpg[/img]

Now I'm working on the first stage and updating the initial location. I also plan to diversify the old quests and add some new content.

notes.title: Update v1.2: New Dungeons
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New Skills[/b][/h1]

It is said that the Guild Forest was visited by the Wandering Adventurer, who came from distant lands in search of legendary relics. In exchange for them, he is ready to give special books with skills that increase the chance of getting rare loot from monsters. Finding the relics has proven difficult, however, and the adventurer cannot do without your help. Talk to him for clues about relics and go on an adventure!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_5a2e1e1a040d48d59e9ca646c0ee766f~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_442,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_5a2e1e1a040d48d59e9ca646c0ee766f~mv2.webp[/img]

[h1][b]Mushroom Cave[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_94d6cba8890b4f16809e63f1461c25ee~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_228,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_94d6cba8890b4f16809e63f1461c25ee~mv2.webp[/img]

Tristan from a Mining Town has an unknown disease. His sister Isabelle decided to go to the Mushroom Cave alone to find a healing mushroom, which is rumored to be able to cure any disease, however, it looks like she is in trouble. Save Isabelle in the Mushroom Cave, the entrance to which can be found in the Miners Valley.

[h1][b]Trees Cave[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_7fbda267d2ec42638a026c9d3fa2111e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_228,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_7fbda267d2ec42638a026c9d3fa2111e~mv2.webp[/img]

The elder of the werewolf camp is confident that many years after the battle with the White Demon, the Guild Forest has begun to recover. The only way to check this is to explore the Trees Cave, which once was the temple of the Goddess of Fertility. Perhaps the Life Tree, which the Goddess of Fertility left behind, began to gradually recover, and the grove of sacred trees will be able to regain its former strength.

[h1][b]Sky City[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_bc16a15ddf2041599436b719fe5aa4fb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_228,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_bc16a15ddf2041599436b719fe5aa4fb~mv2.webp[/img]

There are many legends about the majestic city soaring in the sky. It is said that an ancient civilization used to live there, but after millennia the city turned into ruins. The Sky City Researcher is sure that somewhere there is an ancient artifact with a mysterious power. Perhaps the artifact will appear if you destroy the most powerful golem that protects the city.

notes.title: Silver Cats: Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_81b0d1e2ffe74f03aa21964a1303e789~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_81b0d1e2ffe74f03aa21964a1303e789~mv2.webp[/img]

In the game there is no binding to the character class – the style of play depends on the chosen equipment. You can fight with a one-handed sword, a two-handed sword, or choose a magical artifact if you prefer magic. Armor is divided into three types: plate, cloth, and leather. Plate protects best from physical damage, cloth – from magic damage. The skin has medium protection, but it increases some damage depending on the set of armor: either physical or magical.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_de2fcd29afe0474391a1606427fa49b7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_de2fcd29afe0474391a1606427fa49b7~mv2.webp[/img]

The gameplay of the game changes depending on the chosen difficulty. There are 6 difficulty levels in total: 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_a20b0047e5e24f10bdc135379b558873~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_434,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_a20b0047e5e24f10bdc135379b558873~mv2.webp[/img]

On low difficulty, it is enough to buy armor from merchants, and battles with monsters will not distract from the passage of the story. On high difficulty, you need to get rare materials in order to craft elite equipment. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_6cb48424ca794246b6dc18e19472d47a~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_567,al_c,lg_1,q_90/120ec6_6cb48424ca794246b6dc18e19472d47a~mv2.webp[/img]

It is also necessary to use inlay, sharpening and engraving to increase the characteristics of the equipment. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_490290e07bbb432ab3497edb41062f41~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_493,h_744,al_c,q_90/120ec6_490290e07bbb432ab3497edb41062f41~mv2.webp[/img]

Crafting potions and food is also essential. Resources for them are growing all over the world.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_b6ae289294df4fa6a887835cf0847feb~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_b6ae289294df4fa6a887835cf0847feb~mv2.webp[/img]

By completing various tasks, you can get experience and money, and the rarest things can be obtained from bosses in the dungeons.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/120ec6_c32d7607c9704258b7cf00ead7ef5f22~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/120ec6_c32d7607c9704258b7cf00ead7ef5f22~mv2.webp[/img]
